overall.summary: Of the seven flags screened, only one represents a genuine disclosure concern—the disappearance of specific restructuring expense detail including a $33.7 million equipment upgrade figure from the prior quarter's MD&A. The remaining six flags are largely misaligned peer comparisons, many of which actually demonstrate MIDD's superior transparency on supply chain, tariff, and FX topics relative to peers. MIDD's overall disclosure quality appears reasonable, with the primary area warranting monitoring being the restructuring activity transparency.
